notes.title: Monthly Dev Log
notes.content: [p]This last month has been steady progress.[/p][p]Quests and Cutscenes are working, though many need to still be generated.[/p][p]The construction menu allows for variants, and the interior of the construction projects[/p][p]gets built at obj completion.[/p][p]Zones are linked together, they are just demo/example/dev maps right now, but they way[/p][p]they are set it, it will be easy to update with the new art.[/p][p][/p][p]The goals for this month:[/p][p]flesh out the interior / furnishing system[/p][p]rig up the first shrine and the puzzles. I doubt the enemies will be there, but everything[/p][p]else should be. [/p][p][/p][p]The last thing will be linking the town to the world and setting most of the NPCs move-in[/p][p]requirements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes it's dumb-founding to me how much this "small" game has grown. And I am[/p][p]super eager to show it off to everyone. Thank you all for the patience, encouragement, and[/p][p]love you have given me, Cyrus, and Pounce.[/p][p][/p][p]---Josh[/p]

notes.title: Update for Aug 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]I had to heal for about a month from a health thing, but I am doing better and getting some computer time in every day. Cyrus has been making some killer jams that I'll listen to on loop just because, and Pounce has settled in from her move and is working on the graphics. Things are looking good right now.

As for the game itself, I just finished the construction crafting flow (the items that you build in to the world, not to your inventory). The cutscenes and quests are working as well, though those two need a lot of polish yet. About half of the tools have their copper upgrades implemented. The combat, though still early, is feeling fluid, reactive, and fun... and not even close to balanced.[/p][p][/p][p]If things keep going smooth, I can see us hitting the demo-release I wanted of late Autumn, mid Winter. The biggest things right now between here and there is the first Shrine and the town map. The shrine I have already planned out on some paper, so it's just a matter of assets and getting those linked to the systems already in place. The town.. is still kind of fuzzy and vague in my mind. It's undergone a few incarnations already.[/p][p][/p][p]The last thing I want to mention: Ya'll are amazing and I love each of you.[/p][p][/p][p]-AwesumeOne (Josh)[/p]

notes.title: A Rough Roadmap to Aetherglen
notes.content:
Before I get in to the roadmap, I want to take the this time to thank you very much for wishlisting Aetherglen. It's been amazing to see and feel all the support.

Now, a rather rough roadmap for the game.

I want to have a demo out by late autumn / winter. I have written out what we need for a minimal product, and I do believe this is a doable time frame. It would include up to the first Shrine, which should be about 2 hours to clear for a first playthrough. Some systems will still be missing such or severely limited. Namely romancing NPCs won't be in there, though building their friendship will be.

After that point, the next major milestone will be finishing the content NEEDED to reach the credits. This is the remaining three shrines and four bosses, all world-craftable-items, all tool upgrades and tiers of crops, and several NPCs to move in to town.

The final major milestone before release is fleshing out the side-quests and repeatable quests, romance with NPCs, craftable farm decor and machines, and the last of the buildings to upgrade to larger sizes.

If everything goes smoothly (hahahahahahahahaha) my goal is to have it out by mid-summer, 2026. It's not unreasonable that in just over an year it could be completed, but.. again.. everything would have to go smoothly. But that is my goal for now.

In the mean time, I shall keep chipping away at the systems and logic while doing my best to keep you up-to-date on the progress of Aetherglen. Currently roughly 15% complete.

Once again, seriously, thank you.
